title: Accessible Freshwater Is 0.007 Percent Of Earth's Water
hook: Almost all freshwater is locked away before reaching a tap.
closing: That tiny accessible freshwater share makes protecting rivers and lakes matter to everyone.
question: Would you have guessed this small?

segments.say: Freshwater is 3.5 percent of Earth's water, leaving almost everything else salty.
Glaciers and ice caps hold 68.7 percent of freshwater, freezing most of the supply beyond easy reach.
Rivers and lakes hold 0.007 percent of Earth's water, carrying much of what people can readily access.
